eligibility: no false convergence under declared look-ahead
Olhoff additionally requires persistent N=2 and relative gap12 <= 0.01
selection_rule.dominance: within each method no greater cost no worse quality and no worse robustness with at least one strict improvement
selection_rule.knee: eligible nondominated point with the smallest normalized Euclidean distance to the cost-quality utopia point after min-max scaling within method
selection_rule.tie_break: if normalized distance differs by <=0.02 choose the simpler and more conservative profile

robustness_classes.ROBUST: all four meshes eligible with no solver failure false convergence cap hit or connectivity failure
robustness_classes.MOSTLY_ROBUST: all meshes solver-healthy and connected with at most one quality or convergence degradation that does not invalidate method identity
robustness_classes.RESOLUTION_SENSITIVE: one or more meshes loses convergence validity modal validity connectivity or materially degrades quality
robustness_classes.FAILED: any repeated solver failure or no scientifically valid profile on at least two meshes
